name: Open a PR from the list and load its review detail
description: From the seeded repo's PR list, click into PR #482 and confirm the detail route loads with the PR title and review surface. Exercises nested routing (/repos/<id>/pulls/<number>) and the per-PR detail fetch. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where the demo repo acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo — guaranteed by the e2e-web.yml workflow's fresh seed; run locally against a clean DB (see e2e/README.md). The Findings column header is asserted as FINDINGS because `headRow` sets `text-transform: uppercase` (client .../pulls/styles.ts) and Chrome's `innerText` — what agent-browser matches on — applies text-transform. By contrast the PR title is asserted in full despite rendering truncated, because `text-overflow: ellipsis` is purely visual and does not affect `innerText`.
